title: Tiphys citation linter configuration
description: Roots (local and external), the configured document set, and the citationRequired subset for the `citations` gate. Kernel plan M2, M2-P5 step 2. Expressed entirely in the closed keyword set of M2-D-04 (src/gates/validate.ts): no oneOf/if-then-else, so root-kind-specific shape is not expressed here and is checked in code instead, the same split src/gates/manifest.ts already uses for precondition kinds.

roots.description: Local roots: paths this checkout is expected to contain. A citation matching a local root's glob is resolved against the filesystem (existence, line count, optional content hash).

externalRoots.description: Roots naming a repository this checkout does NOT contain (kernel plan M2 section 3, M2-P5 grounding: the firstmate scouted clone). External roots are matched FIRST, before local roots, so a bare relative path that would otherwise collide with this repository's own tree (bin/fm-lock.sh vs this repo's bin/) resolves deterministically rather than being guessed. A citation matching an external root is recorded unverifiable-external with provenance and is never counted as a resolved unit.

documents.description: Path globs identifying the configured document set this gate ever looks at, diff-scoped at run time (M2-D-10) and walked in full only by the one-shot inventory (kernel plan M2-P5 step 5, not a standing gate mode).

citationRequired.description: The subset of `documents` in which zero recognized citations is red (M2R-014's narrowed vacuous guard: plans, reviews, verifications). Every glob here must also appear in `documents`; checked in code, not expressible in the closed keyword set.

match.description: Explicit path globs (segments separated by /, * matches within one segment, ** matches zero or more segments). A glob listed under more than one root (local or external, the identical glob string) is a config error, reported as error, never guessed (kernel plan M2-P5 criterion 5).
